newsitem.title: BULGARIA: ATHLETICS-KOSTADINOVA VOTED BULGARIA'S ATHLETE OF YEAR.
newsitem.headline: ATHLETICS-KOSTADINOVA VOTED BULGARIA'S ATHLETE OF YEAR.

text.p: Bulgarian women's Olympic champion and world high jump record holder Stefka Kostadinova was voted the country's athlete of the year for the fourth time on Friday.
Kostadinova, 30, won her first Olympic gold in Atlanta with a clearance of 2.05 metres.
In 1995 she won the world title in Gothenburg with a clearance of 2.01 metres to reclaim the honour she won in Rome in 1987 with the current world record of 2.09.
Married to her coach Nikolai Petrov, she became a mother for the first time in January last year and was back to training in April 1995.
She said she would continue competing as long as she keeps on winning and will retire when she feels the time is right.
